author: /root/oraculo_metodo_r2
proof_domain: Canonical UTF-8 serialization of every semantic instance accepted by the schema.
canonical_serialization: RFC8259 compact JSON with recursively lexicographically sorted object keys, arrays preserved, Unicode emitted directly except mandatory JSON escapes, and no insignificant whitespace.

recurrence.bounded_string: S(n)=2+6*n bytes. Six bytes per Unicode code point is conservative for mandatory control-character escaping; quotes are included.
recurrence.enum: Maximum byte length of a canonical serialized enum member.
preconditions: Every declared object property is required.
No unbounded reference or recursive schema exists.

raw_output_rule: The original output remains byte-identical to the last agent message and is separately rejected above 65536 raw UTF-8 bytes. Canonicalization is proof-only and never repairs, truncates or replaces output.
preflight_obligation: An independent analyzer must reproduce 47353 and verify the runtime raw-byte cap before any behavioral session.
